description: Renders one page of the site in a real browser and returns the image, so you can check layout, spacing, and responsive behaviour that source-level checks cannot see. `path` is site-relative and may include a query string, so dynamic routes are captured with real values rather than placeholders. Focus the capture with `selector` (plus optional `padding` for surrounding context) or a `clip` rectangle in CSS pixels from the top-left of the page; the region is scrolled into view and captured within the configured viewport, so it must fit inside it, and these options exclude each other and `fullPage`. Fonts, images, and (for `fullPage`) lazy content are awaited before the capture, and CSS animations are fast-forwarded to their end state by default. Fails with 409 when the draft build is still in progress or has failed; poll `websiteSourceCode.deployment.status` and retry.

clip.description: Crop to this rectangle, in CSS pixels from the top-left of the rendered page at the chosen viewport; it is scrolled into view and must fit within the viewport. Only for regions no selector frames.

colorScheme.description: Browser color preference to emulate. Omit it to use the renderer default.

delayMs.description: Extra settle time before capturing, in milliseconds.

freezeAnimations.description: Fast-forward CSS animations and transitions to their end state so captures are deterministic.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Excludes `selector` and `clip`.

padding.description: CSS pixels of surrounding page to include on every side of the `selector` match.

path.description: Site-relative path to render, including any query string, e.g. `/blog/my-post`.

scrollTo.description: Scroll to a CSS selector or an absolute Y offset before capturing.

selector.description: Crop to the first element matching this CSS selector, scrolled into view. Preferred: it follows the layout at every viewport.

target.description: `head` renders the current draft; `published` renders the live site.

waitForSelector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to match before capturing.

name: websitePreview_capture
title: Capture a page screenshot
